Global (All).summary: Russia launches a series of hypersonic missile tests near the Norwegian border, increasing tensions.
Iran and Saudi Arabia agree to re-establish diplomatic relations after years of tensions.
The US Federal Reserve announces a 25-basis-point rate hike to combat inflation, sparking market volatility.

United States.title: Protests Erupt at US Supreme Court Over Abortion Rights
United States.summary: Thousands gathered outside the US Supreme Court building on August 8 to protest the reversal of Roe v Wade, sparking clashes with police.

United States.title: FBI Arrests Suspect in Connection with US Capitol Breach
United States.summary: On August 6, the FBI apprehended a man suspected of participating in the 2021 storming of the US Capitol, highlighting ongoing concerns about domestic extremism.

United States.title: US Senate Blocks Electoral Count Reform Act
United States.summary: A proposed bill to reform the electoral count process in the US Senate was blocked on August 1, sparking debate about the legitimacy of US elections.

South Korea.title: Tensions rise between South Korea and Japan over export restrictions
South Korea.summary: South Korea and Japan have a long-standing trade dispute, but recent export restrictions imposed by Japan have caused tensions to rise. This raises concerns for South Korea's economy and political relations with Japan.

South Korea.title: Protests break out in Seoul over plans to relocate the presidential office
South Korea.summary: A plan to relocate the presidential office in Seoul has sparked protests from locals who are concerned about the impact on their community. The protests have disrupted traffic and raised concerns about social stability.

South Korea.title: North Korea launches ballistic missile, sparking concerns about security
South Korea.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile towards the East Sea, sparking concerns about security in the region. The launch has been condemned by the international community, and tensions between North and South Korea remain high.

Japan.title: Tokyo 2023 Festival to be Canceled Due to Economic Concerns
Japan.summary:
The 2023 Tokyo Festival is at risk of being canceled due to economic concerns. 
        This has raised questions about the event's financial viability.

Japan.title: North Korea's Potential Missile Test
Japan.summary:
North Korea has made statements indicating a potential missile test soon. 
        This has raised concerns about regional security.

Japan.title: Japan's F-35 Fighter Jet Controversy
Japan.summary:
Japan's acquisition of the F-35 fighter jet has raised controversy. 
        Critics argue it is too expensive and lacks capabilities.
